title.rendered: You Are the Righteousness of God: The Gospel For Today

excerpt.rendered: You did not earn it and you cannot lose it, you are the righteousness of God in Christ Jesus. Not after you improve. Right now, by faith, through the finished work of the cross.

content.rendered:
The Gospel For Today | Sunday, May 3, 2026

📖 Today’s Scripture

“God made him who had no sin to be sin for us, so that in him we might become the righteousness of God.”
2 Corinthians 5:21 (NIV) | ESV

📝 Today’s Message

This may be the most radical exchange in all of Scripture. Jesus, who knew no sin, became sin. Not just bore it, not just covered it. Became it. So that you, who knew no righteousness of your own, might become the righteousness of God. Not possess a little righteousness. Not be counted somewhat righteous. Become the very righteousness of God in Christ Jesus.

Religion offers improvement. The Gospel offers exchange. You do not get better and better until you are righteous enough to stand before God. You receive, by faith, a righteousness that is not yours by performance but His by nature, gifted to you at the cross, permanent and complete.

This means your standing before God is not determined by your last week, your last thought, or your last failure. It is determined by what Jesus did. And what Jesus did never changes. Romans 5:17 says those who receive the abundance of grace and the gift of righteousness will reign in life through Jesus Christ. Not survive. Not cope. Reign. That is your position in Christ, not because of what you have done, but because of what He has already done for you.

The accuser wants you to measure your righteousness by your performance. The Gospel measures it by the cross. These are two completely different measuring sticks, and only one of them is true. Today, walk in that.

🙏 Prayer

Father, I receive by faith what I could never earn by effort, the righteousness of God in Christ Jesus. I am not condemned, I am not on probation, and I am not working my way toward Your acceptance. I am already accepted, already righteous, already beloved, in Christ. I stand in that truth today. In Jesus’ name. Amen.

🗣️ Declaration

I am the righteousness of God in Christ Jesus. My standing before God is not based on my performance but on the finished work of Jesus at the cross. I am accepted, loved, and fully righteous, not because I earned it but because He gave it. I reign in life through the abundance of grace and the gift of righteousness. This is who I am in Christ, today and every day.
